issues.title: CRT-001: Project charter & definition of done
issues.body:
## Goal
Agree how Team A works and what “done” means for every CRT task.

## Description
Write a short charter covering scope, out-of-scope (Interview is Team B), sprint cadence, PR rules, and Definition of Done.

## Tasks
- List in-scope CRT modules for v1 vs later
- Define DoD: UI + RLS + tests/manual checklist + docs note
- Define how you integrate with ULearn `crt.access` permission

## Expected output
- `CHARTER.md` in this repo
- DoD checklist copied into issue templates
- Explicit list of systems you will NOT build (Auth, Labels admin, Interview)

issues.title: CRT-002: ULearn integration contract (auth + Allowed CRT)
issues.body:
## Goal
CRT must only open for users with `crt.access`.

## Description
Document and implement the contract with the main ULearn app: login session, permission check, redirect when denied.

## Tasks
- Confirm `crt.access` and label `allowed_crt` in Supabase
- Document how CRT UI reads `AuthService.hasPermission('crt.access')` (or equivalent API)
- Deny access path for students without permission

## Expected output
- `docs/ULEARN_CONTRACT.md`
- Working gate on `/crt` (or CRT shell route)
- Manual test notes: with permission → enter; without → blocked

issues.title: CRT-003: CRT information architecture & wireframes
issues.body:
## Goal
Clear student + admin screens before building.

## Description
Wireframe student home, path detail, practice session, results, and CRT admin content screens.

## Tasks
- Student: CRT home, path, practice, result
- Admin: modules, questions, assign path to batch
- Empty / loading / error states

## Expected output
- Figma or markdown wireframes in `docs/wireframes/`
- Screen inventory checklist approved by product owner

issues.title: CRT-004: Database schema v1 for CRT
issues.body:
## Goal
Supabase tables for CRT content and progress with RLS.

## Description
Design tables: tracks/paths, modules, questions, attempts, scores. RLS: students read published + own attempts; CRT admins manage content.

## Tasks
- ERD
- Migration SQL with RLS
- Seed 1 sample path with 5 questions

## Expected output
- Migration file applied on linked project (or PR-ready)
- ERD in `docs/schema.md`
- RLS verified with student vs admin roles

issues.title: CRT-010: Learning path & module CRUD (admin)
issues.body:
## Goal
CRT admins create paths (e.g. Service company track) and modules (Aptitude, Reasoning…).

## Description
Admin UI + APIs to create/edit/reorder modules inside a path. Publish/draft status.

## Expected output
- Admin screens for path/module CRUD
- Draft vs published behavior
- Demo path “Campus Service Track v1” created

issues.title: CRT-011: Question bank authoring (MCQ)
issues.body:
## Goal
Authors add MCQs with topic tags, difficulty, explanation, correct option.

## Description
Support create/edit/delete, filter by topic/difficulty, attach to modules.

## Expected output
- Question form with validation
- List + filters
- At least 30 seeded MCQs across 3 topics
- Students never see `correct_index` outside review-after-submit flows

issues.title: CRT-012: Bulk question import (CSV/Excel)
issues.body:
## Goal
Import large banks without one-by-one entry.

## Description
CSV/XLSX template + import job with row errors reported.

## Expected output
- Downloadable template
- Import report: success/fail per row
- Imported questions appear in bank

issues.title: CRT-013: Student CRT home & path enrollment
issues.body:
## Goal
Allowed-CRT students see their paths and continue where they left off.

## Description
Home shows assigned paths, progress %, next recommended module.

## Expected output
- `/crt` home with progress cards
- Continue CTA
- Empty state when no path assigned

issues.title: CRT-020: Timed practice session (MCQ)
issues.body:
## Goal
Student starts a timed practice set and submits answers.

## Description
Timer, question navigator, autosave answers, submit, prevent continue after time.

## Expected output
- Practice session UI
- Server-validated time window / duration
- Attempt row stored with answers JSON
- Result summary page (score, time used)

issues.title: CRT-021: Sectional practice (topic filters)
issues.body:
## Goal
Practice only one topic (e.g. percentages) for a chosen count/time.

## Expected output
- Topic picker
- Configurable question count
- Results broken down by topic

issues.title: CRT-022: Coding drill MVP (reuse patterns)
issues.body:
## Goal
Simple coding practice problems with public tests.

## Description
Align with existing exam coding patterns if possible; keep CRT coding lighter than recruitment exams.

## Expected output
- Coding problem schema
- Run public tests
- Store submission + pass/fail
- 5 sample coding drills

issues.title: CRT-023: Attempt history & review mode
issues.body:
## Goal
Students review past attempts with explanations after submit.

## Expected output
- History list
- Review screen: chosen vs correct + explanation
- No review of correct answers mid-attempt

issues.title: CRT-030: Full mock CRT test
issues.body:
## Goal
Multi-section mock mimicking a campus drive day.

## Description
Fixed blueprint (e.g. 60Q / 60min or configurable), one attempt policy option, score report.

## Expected output
- Mock configuration in admin
- Student start/submit flow
- Section-wise score report

issues.title: CRT-031: Readiness score engine
issues.body:
## Goal
Compute a 0–100 readiness score from recent practice + mocks.

## Description
Document formula (weights for accuracy, speed, coverage, mock score). Recalculate on attempt complete.

## Expected output
- Documented formula in `docs/readiness.md`
- Stored readiness per student per path
- Visible on CRT home

issues.title: CRT-032: Topic mastery heatmap
issues.body:
## Goal
Show weak/strong topics visually.

## Expected output
- Heatmap or skill bars on profile/path page
- Data from attempts aggregated by topic tag

issues.title: CRT-033: Certificates / badges MVP
issues.body:
## Goal
Award a badge when readiness ≥ threshold or mock passed.

## Expected output

- Badge shown on CRT profile
- Optional shareable certificate PDF/PNG
